import Mathlib.Algebra.MonoidAlgebra.Degree
import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.Eval
import Mathlib.Order.ConditionallyCompleteLattice.Finset
import Mathlib.Basic.Real.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Finsupp.Weight
import Mathlib.RingTheory.MvPowerSeries.NoZeroDivisors
import Mathlib.Tactic
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.RingDivision
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Taylor
open MvPolynomial
namespace AevalRename159
variable {R σ : Type*} [CommSemiring R]
#check_failure Roth.aeval_X_eq_rename
#check @Polynomial.toMvPolynomial_eq_rename_comp
#print Polynomial.toMvPolynomial_eq_rename_comp
#check @MvPolynomial.uniqueAlgEquiv
#check @MvPolynomial.rename_polynomial_aeval_X
theorem oldForm (i : σ) (f : Polynomial R) :
    Polynomial.aeval (X i : MvPolynomial σ R) f =
      rename (fun _ : Unit ↦ i) ((uniqueAlgEquiv R Unit).symm f) :=
  AlgHom.congr_fun (Polynomial.toMvPolynomial_eq_rename_comp i) f
-- A bundled equality supports rewriting all inputs simultaneously.
theorem bundled (i : σ) : Polynomial.toMvPolynomial (R := R) i =
    (rename (fun _ : Unit ↦ i)).comp (uniqueAlgEquiv R Unit).symm :=
  Polynomial.toMvPolynomial_eq_rename_comp i
-- Arbitrary one-element representations are valid, without finiteness assumptions.
theorem uniqueForm {ι : Type*} [Unique ι] (i : σ) (f : Polynomial R) :
    Polynomial.aeval (X i : MvPolynomial σ R) f =
      rename (fun _ : ι ↦ i) ((uniqueAlgEquiv R ι).symm f) := by
  have h : Polynomial.aeval (X i : MvPolynomial σ R) =
      (rename (fun _ : ι ↦ i)).comp (uniqueAlgEquiv R ι).symm := by
    apply Polynomial.algHom_ext
    simp
  exact AlgHom.congr_fun h f
-- Replacing the named coordinate by an arbitrary element changes the meaning.
theorem falseGeneralization :
    ¬ (∀ f : Polynomial ℕ, Polynomial.aeval (0 : MvPolynomial Unit ℕ) f =
      rename (fun _ : Unit ↦ ()) ((uniqueAlgEquiv ℕ Unit).symm f)) := by
  intro h
  have hh := h Polynomial.X
  have hc := congrArg (fun P : MvPolynomial Unit ℕ ↦ P.coeff (Finsupp.single () 1)) hh
  norm_num at hc
#print axioms oldForm
#print axioms bundled
#print axioms uniqueForm
#print axioms falseGeneralization
end AevalRename159

@Polynomial.toMvPolynomial_eq_rename_comp : ∀ {R : Type u_3} {σ : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R] (i : σ),
  Polynomial.toMvPolynomial i = (rename fun x ↦ i).comp ↑(uniqueAlgEquiv R Unit).symm

theorem Polynomial.toMvPolynomial_eq_rename_comp.{u_1, u_3} : ∀ {R : Type u_1} {σ : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R]
  (i : σ), Polynomial.toMvPolynomial i = (rename fun x ↦ i).comp ↑(uniqueAlgEquiv R Unit).symm :=
fun {R} {σ} [CommSemiring R] i ↦
  Polynomial.algHom_ext
    (ext ((Polynomial.toMvPolynomial i) Polynomial.X)
      (((rename fun x ↦ i).comp ↑(uniqueAlgEquiv R Unit).symm) Polynomial.X) fun m ↦
      of_eq_true
        (Eq.trans
          (congr
            (congrArg Eq
              (congrFun' (congrArg DFunLike.coe (congrArg AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff (Polynomial.toMvPolynomial_X i))) m))
            (congrFun'
              (congrArg DFunLike.coe
                (congrArg AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff
                  (Eq.trans
                    (congrArg (⇑(rename fun x ↦ i))
                      (Eq.trans (uniqueAlgEquiv_symm_apply R Unit Polynomial.X) (Polynomial.eval₂_X C (X PUnit.unit))))
                    (rename_X (fun x ↦ i) PUnit.unit))))
              m))
          (eq_self ((X i).coeff m))))

uniqueAlgEquiv : (R : Type u_3) →
  [inst : CommSemiring R] → (σ : Type u_4) → [Unique σ] → MvPolynomial σ R ≃ₐ[R] Polynomial R

rename_polynomial_aeval_X : ∀ (R : Type u_3) [inst : CommSemiring R] {σ : Type u_4} {τ : Type u_5} (f : σ → τ) (i : σ)
  (p : Polynomial R), (rename f) ((Polynomial.aeval (X i)) p) = (Polynomial.aeval (X (f i))) p
